observations: internal-result dominates (22/40), concentrated in observations, interpretations, evidence-lines, and plans that narrate the project's own simulations and NHANES/SWAN/CGMacros fits. truly-orphaned (13/40) clusters almost entirely in these narrative epistemic entities: summary numbers with no pipeline/results-path or entity anchor -- the real signal a provenance check should keep. Datasets are cleanly external-cite and frontmatter-source-covers (the entity IS the source of record). Most false positives fall in three families the lint should suppress: structural tokens (license/array-model/release/entity IDs, 5), stipulated design params (alpha, pre-reg gates, perturbation/seed budgets, 3), and undetected prose citations 'Author (Year)' plus inline results/ paths the anchor detector missed. A redesign should whitelist version/ID/license tokens, recognize pre-registered params, and parse prose citations and results paths before flagging.
